params.doc: Flag to only include entries with cost centers. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyNotes
params.doc: Flag to only include entries with notes. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyOpen
params.doc: Flag to only include open orders (incomplete status like 'Open' as opposed to completed status like 'Paid'). Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyOverdue
params.doc: Flag to only include orders that are overdue (past the due date). Defaults to false.

params.name: personId
params.doc: The ID of a person to filter by.

params.name: query
params.doc: Fulltext search query.

params.name: sort
params.doc: The column to sort the list by. Defaults to 'date'.

params.name: start
params.doc: The starting entry. Defaults to 0.

params.name: statusId
params.doc: The ID of the order status to filter by.

params.name: type
params.doc: The type of order (sales or purchase).

operations.title: Create payment
operations.doc: Creates a new payment. This must first be executed before downloading the pain.001 or PDF file with the next endpoint, otherwise we won't be able to match the payments from a camt.052/053/054 file later on. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: date
params.doc: The execution date for the payment. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: orderIds
params.doc: The IDs of the selected orders, comma-separated.

params.name: amount
params.doc: A partial payment amount per order. Leave empty to pay all open amounts.

params.name: isCombine
params.doc: If set, merges multiple payments to the same payee into one transaction.

params.name: statusId
params.doc: The ID of the new status for the order.

params.name: type
params.doc: The type of payment and file to generate. Defaults to PAIN (pain.001).

operations.title: Download file
operations.doc: Downloads the pain.001 or PDF file. Please use the create endpoint first, and then use the same parameters to download the file here. Returns a file.

params.name: date
params.doc: The execution date for the payment. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: orderIds
params.doc: The IDs of the selected orders, comma-separated.

params.name: amount
params.doc: A partial payment amount per order. Leave empty to pay all open amounts.

params.name: isCombine
params.doc: If set, merges multiple payments to the same payee into one transaction.

params.name: statusId
params.doc: The ID of the new status for the order.

params.name: type
params.doc: The type of payment and file to generate. Defaults to PAIN (pain.001).

operations.title: Read order
operations.doc: Returns a single order by ID.

params.name: id
params.doc: The ID of the entry.

operations.title: Update order
operations.doc: Updates an existing order. Note that all parameters must be submitted, omitted parameters are treated as empty values. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: associateId
params.doc: The ID of the business partner (customer / vendor). See Person.

params.name: categoryId
params.doc: The ID of the category. See Order category.

params.name: date
params.doc: The date of the order. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: id
params.doc: The ID of the order to update.

params.name: accountId
params.doc: The ID of the account. Leave empty to use the account from the category. See Account.

params.name: attachments
params.doc: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: fileId
sub.doc: ID of the file to attach. See File.

params.name: currencyId
params.doc: The ID of the currency. Leave empty to use the default currency. See Currency.

params.name: currencyRate
params.doc: The exchange rate from foreign currency to main currency. Only required if the currency is not supported or if you want to use a different rate than suggested.

params.name: custom
params.doc: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values>. Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: daysBefore
params.doc: The next order will be created X days before the start date. Leave empty or set to 0 to have the next order created on the start date itself. See recurrence parameter.

params.name: description
params.doc: A description of the order document.

params.name: discountPercentage
params.doc: The discount percentage for the entire order (can be overriden in items).

params.name: dueDays
params.doc: The due days. Order date + due days = Due date (the date, when payment is due).

params.name: endDate
params.doc: The end date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). Orders repeat automatically up until this date, when the recurrence will stop. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: groupId
params.doc: The ID of the order group (dossier). Use this to include the order in a dossier with other orders that belong together (e.g. the offer, order confirmation, delivery note and invoice of the same order). This is overridden by previousId (if both are set).

params.name: isDisplayItemGross
params.doc: Whether to display item totals as gross (including tax). Defaults to false (net).

params.name: items
params.doc: The list of order items. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: accountId
sub.doc: The ID of the account (revenue account for sales, expense account for purchase). See Account.

sub.name: name
sub.doc: The name of the item.

sub.name: unitPrice
sub.doc: The price of the item (for one unit).

sub.name: allocations
sub.doc: Allocations to cost centers. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: share
sub.doc: Allocation share. For example, if you have two cost centers, and one has a share of 3, and the other has a share of 1, then the amount is allocated 3:1 (which equals 75% to 25%).

sub.name: toCostCenterId
sub.doc: ID of cost center to allocate to. See Cost center.

sub.name: articleNr
sub.doc: The article number.

sub.name: description
sub.doc: A description of the item.

sub.name: discountPercentage
sub.doc: Discount percentage for the item price.

sub.name: inventoryId
sub.doc: The ID of the inventory article. See Inventory.

sub.name: quantity
sub.doc: The amount of units of the item. Defaults to 1.

sub.name: taxId
sub.doc: The ID of the tax code. See Tax codes.

sub.name: type
sub.doc: The type of item. Defaults to ARTICLE.

sub.name: unitId
sub.doc: The ID of the unit (pcs., hours, etc.). See Units.

params.name: language
params.doc: The language of the document.

params.name: notes
params.doc: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: notifyEmail
params.doc: The e-mail address to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyPersonId
params.doc: The ID of the person to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyType
params.doc: Whether to send a notification e-mail when orders have been created or not. Leave empty to not send any notification.

params.name: notifyUserId
params.doc: The ID of the user to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter. Note: User must be in this organization.

params.name: nr
params.doc: The order number (e.g. 'IN-2001015' for an invoice). Leave empty to generate the number with sequenceNumberId. This becomes mandatory if a sequence number is set neither here nor in the order category.

params.name: previousId
params.doc: The ID of the previous order from which this order is created (Next step / Continue as). The new order will be grouped with the previous order in a dossier. See also groupId. This will override groupId (if both are set).

params.name: recurrence
params.doc: The interval of how often the order should be automatically repeated. Leave empty to not repeat the order. See also startDate and endDate.

params.name: responsiblePersonId
params.doc: The ID of the responsible person (Sachbearbeiter). See Person.

params.name: roundingId
params.doc: The ID of the rounding to use for the grand total. See Rounding.

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.doc: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the order number (see nr). If empty, the sequence number of the category is used (if set). See Sequence number.

params.name: startDate
params.doc: The start date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). This is the date when the order will be repeated next. Should probably be called nextDate instead. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: statusId
params.doc: The ID of the status to set. Leave empty to use the first status in the list. See Order category.

operations.title: Update attachments
operations.doc: Updates the file attachments of an order. Use the File API to upload a file and then use the file ID here. Returns either a success or error message.

params.name: id
params.doc: The ID of the entry.

params.name: fileIds
params.doc: A list of file IDs, comma-separated. Leave empty to remove all attachments. Use the File API to upload a file and then use the file ID here.

operations.title: Update recurrence
operations.doc: Updates the recurrence of an existing order by order ID. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: id
params.doc: The ID of the order.

params.name: daysBefore
params.doc: The next order will be created X days before the start date. Leave empty or set to 0 to have the next order created on the start date itself. See recurrence parameter.

params.name: endDate
params.doc: The end date for the recurrence. Orders repeat automatically up until this date, when the recurrence will stop. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: notifyEmail
params.doc: The e-mail address to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyPersonId
params.doc: The ID of the person to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyType
params.doc: Whether or not to send a notification e-mail when orders have been created. Leave empty to not send any notification.

params.name: notifyUserId
params.doc: The ID of the user to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter. Note: User must be in this organization.

params.name: recurrence
params.doc: The interval of how often the order should be automatically repeated. Leave empty to not repeat the order (or to remove recurrence).

params.name: startDate
params.doc: The start date for the recurrence. This is the date when the order will be repeated next. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

operations.title: Update status
operations.doc: Updates the status of an existing order by order ID. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: ids
params.doc: The IDs of one or multiple orders, comma-separated.

params.name: statusId
params.doc: The ID of the new status.

operations.title: Categorize people
operations.doc: Assigns one or multiple people to the desired category. Returns either a success or error message.

params.name: ids
params.doc: The IDs of the entries to categorize, comma-separated.

params.name: target
params.doc: The ID of the target category.

operations.title: Create category
operations.doc: Creates a new category. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: name
params.doc: The name of the category. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: discountPercentage
params.doc: Discount percentage for people in this category, which may be used for orders.

params.name: parentId
params.doc: The ID of the parent category.

params.name: sequenceNrId
params.doc: The ID of the sequence number used for people in this category. If empty, the sequence number of the parent category is inherited.

operations.title: Delete categories
operations.doc: Deletes one or multiple existing categories. Note that you can only delete empty categories. Returns either a success or error message.

params.name: ids
params.doc: The IDs of the selected entries, comma-separated.

operations.title: List categories
operations.doc: Returns a list of all categories.

operations.title: Read category
operations.doc: Returns a single category by ID.

params.name: id
params.doc: The ID of the entry.

operations.title: Get tree of categories
operations.doc: Returns a tree of all categories or the tree below a parent category.

params.name: id
params.doc: Optional ID of the parent category (omit to get all categories).

operations.title: Update category
operations.doc: Updates an existing category. Note that all parameters must be submitted, omitted parameters are treated as empty values. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: id
params.doc: The ID of the category to update.

params.name: name
params.doc: The name of the category. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: discountPercentage
params.doc: Discount percentage for people in this category, which may be used for orders.

params.name: parentId
params.doc: The ID of the parent category.

params.name: sequenceNrId
params.doc: The ID of the sequence number used for people in this category. If empty, the sequence number of the parent category is inherited.

operations.title: Create person
operations.doc: Creates a new person. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: company
params.doc: The name of the organization / company. Either firstName, lastName or company must be set.

params.name: firstName
params.doc: The person's first (given) name. Either firstName, lastName or company must be set.

params.name: lastName
params.doc: The person's last (family) name. Either firstName, lastName or company must be set.

params.name: addresses
params.doc: A list of addresses (street, house number, zip, city, country). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: type
sub.doc: The type of address. Main address, invoice address, etc.

sub.name: address
sub.doc: The address (street, house number, additional info). Can contain multiple lines.

sub.name: canton
sub.doc: The canton of the address (Switzerland only).

sub.name: city
sub.doc: The town / city of the address.

sub.name: company
sub.doc: Company name of the recipient.

sub.name: country
sub.doc: The country of the address.

sub.name: firstName
sub.doc: First name of the recipient.

sub.name: isHideCompany
sub.doc: Do not display the company name in the document address window.

sub.name: isHideName
sub.doc: Do not display the title, first name and last name in the document address window.

sub.name: lastName
sub.doc: Last name of the recipient.

sub.name: zip
sub.doc: The postal code of the address.

params.name: altName
params.doc: An alternative name for this person (for organizational chart). This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: attachments
params.doc: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: fileId
sub.doc: ID of the file to attach. See File.

params.name: bankAccounts
params.doc: A list of bank accounts (IBAN, BIC). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: iban
sub.doc: The IBAN (International Bank Account Number).

sub.name: type
sub.doc: The type of bank account, i.e. what is the bank account used for?

sub.name: bic
sub.doc: The BIC (Business Identifier Code) of your bank.

sub.name: notes
sub.doc: Some optional notes.

params.name: bankData
params.doc: Unstructured bank information, if IBAN/BIC not available. Otherwise use bankAccounts.

params.name: categoryId
params.doc: The ID of the category. See Person category.

params.name: certificateTemplateId
params.doc: The ID of the salary certificate template. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: certificateValues
params.doc: Values to print directly on the employee's salary certificate. isEmployee must be true, otherwise this is ignored. This overrides any values set on the salary certificate template. This is a map of code -> value, for example: {"F": true, "2.3a": "Bonus"}

params.name: children
params.doc: A list of children. isEmployee or isFamily must be set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: name
sub.doc: Name of the child (first and last name).

sub.name: dateBenefitBegin
sub.doc: Child benefit start date (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateBenefitEnd
sub.doc: Child benefit end date (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateBirth
sub.doc: The child's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateInEducation
sub.doc: Date since child is in education (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: notes
sub.doc: Some optional notes.

params.name: color
params.doc: The color to use for this person in the organizational chart. Leave empty for white.

params.name: contacts
params.doc: A list of contact information (e-mail, phone, url, etc.). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: address
sub.doc: The actual contact information (e-mail address, phone number, etc.).

sub.name: type
sub.doc: The type of contact information.

sub.name: notes
sub.doc: Some optional short notes.

params.name: custom
params.doc: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values>. Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: dateBirth
params.doc: The person's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: department
params.doc: The department of the person within the company.

params.name: discountPercentage
params.doc: Discount percentage for this person, which may be used for orders. This can also be set on the category for all people in that category.

params.name: industry
params.doc: The industry of the company or the trade/vocation of the person.

params.name: insuranceContracts
params.doc: A list of insurance contracts, if isInsurance is set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: typeId
sub.doc: ID of the insurance type (e.g. AHV, BVG, etc.).

sub.name: contractNr
sub.doc: Number of the contract with the insurance company.

sub.name: subNr
sub.doc: Optional sub-contract number, if sub-contracts exist.

params.name: insuranceMemberNr
params.doc: Member number (for insurance). isInsurance must be set.

params.name: insuranceNr
params.doc: Insurance number. isInsurance must be set.

params.name: isAutoFillResponsiblePerson
params.doc: Whether to autofill the responsible person field in order documents with this person if userId is set.

params.name: isCustomer
params.doc: Is the person a customer? (role)

params.name: isEmployee
params.doc: Is the person an employee? (role)

params.name: isFamily
params.doc: Is the person a family? (role)

params.name: isInactive
params.doc: Mark the person as inactive. The person will be greyed out and no longer suggested. Defaults to false.

params.name: isInsurance
params.doc: Is the person an insurance company? (role)

params.name: isVendor
params.doc: Is the person a vendor? (role)

params.name: language
params.doc: The main language of the person. May be used for documents.

params.name: locationId
params.doc: The ID of the location (workplace) of the employee. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: notes
params.doc: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: nr
params.doc: The person number (e.g. customer no.).

params.name: position
params.doc: The position (job title) of the person within the company.

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.doc: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the person number (see nr). If this is empty, the sequence number will not update when nr is set. See Sequence number.

params.name: servicePeriods
params.doc: A list of service periods (entry and exit of the employee). isEmployee must be set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: dateEntry
sub.doc: The entry date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateExit
sub.doc: The exit date. Leave empty if this is the current period. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: notes
sub.doc: Some optional notes.

params.name: ssn
params.doc: Social security number of the employee. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: superiorId
params.doc: The superior of this person (for organizational chart).

params.name: titleId
params.doc: The person's title (e.g. 'Mr.', 'Mrs.', 'Dr.'). See Person title.

params.name: userId
params.doc: The ID of the user linked to this person. This is a user that can login to CashCtrl. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: vatUid
params.doc: The UID (VAT no.) of the company.

operations.title: Delete people
operations.doc: Deletes one or multiple people. Returns either a success or error message.

params.name: ids
params.doc: The IDs of the selected entries, comma-separated.

operations.title: Create import
operations.doc: Creates a new import session. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: fileId
params.doc: File to import. Valid formats: vCard, Excel and CSV. Max. size: 5 MB. Use the File API to upload a file and then use the file ID here.

params.name: categoryId
params.doc: Category for all new people, overriding imported categories.

operations.title: Execute import
operations.doc: Executes the importing of people from the import session.

params.name: id
params.doc: Import session ID from the Create endpoint.

params.name: indexes
params.doc: Index numbers of people to import, comma-separated. All other people are ignored. You can get the indexes from the JSON response of the Preview endpoint. Omit this parameter to import all people.

operations.title: Define mapping
operations.doc: Defines the mapping from Excel / CSV column header names to CashCtrl fields. This step is not needed for vCards. See List mapping fields endpoint for a list of field names. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: id
params.doc: Import session ID from the Create endpoint.

params.name: mapping
params.doc: Mapping from columns (Excel/CSV) to fields in CashCtrl. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: from
sub.doc: Column header name in Excel/CSV.

sub.name: to
sub.doc: Field name in CashCtrl. See List mapping fields endpoint for a list of field names.

operations.title: List mapping fields
operations.doc: Lists the fields available in CashCtrl for mapping. Used in the Define mapping endpoint.

operations.title: Preview import
operations.doc: Previews the imported people. Returns a list of people that will be imported. This step can be omitted.

params.name: id
params.doc: Import session ID from the Create endpoint.

operations.title: Export to CSV
operations.doc: Returns a CSV file of the people list.

params.name: categoryId
params.doc: The ID of the category to filter by.

params.name: columns
params.doc: The columns to include in the list, comma-separated. Check the list.json for available column names.

params.name: dir
params.doc: The direction of the sort order (ascending or descending). Defaults to 'ASC'.

params.name: filter
params.doc: An array of filters to filter the list. All filters must match (AND). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: comparison
sub.doc: Comparison type. Defaults to 'like'.

sub.name: field
sub.doc: The name of the column to filter by.

sub.name: value
sub.doc: Text to filter by, or a JSON array of multiple values (OR).

params.name: limit
params.doc: The number of entries to retrieve. Defaults to 100.

params.name: onlyActive
params.doc: Flag to include only active people. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyCustomers
params.doc: Flag to include only customers. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyEmployees
params.doc: Flag to include only employees. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyFamilies
params.doc: Flag to include only families. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyInsurances
params.doc: Flag to include only insurances. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyNotes
params.doc: Flag to only include entries with notes. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyVendors
params.doc: Flag to include only vendors. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyWithImages
params.doc: Flag to include only people with images. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyWithoutCategory
params.doc: Flag to include only people without a category. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyWithoutRole
params.doc: Flag to include only people without a role. Defaults to false.

params.name: query
params.doc: Fulltext search query.

params.name: sort
params.doc: The column to sort the list by. Defaults to 'name'.

params.name: start
params.doc: The starting entry. Defaults to 0.

operations.title: List people
operations.doc: Returns a list of people.

params.name: categoryId
params.doc: The ID of the category to filter by.

params.name: dir
params.doc: The direction of the sort order (ascending or descending). Defaults to 'ASC'.

params.name: filter
params.doc: An array of filters to filter the list. All filters must match (AND). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: comparison
sub.doc: Comparison type. Defaults to 'like'.

sub.name: field
sub.doc: The name of the column to filter by.

sub.name: value
sub.doc: Text to filter by, or a JSON array of multiple values (OR).

params.name: limit
params.doc: The number of entries to retrieve. Defaults to 100.

params.name: onlyActive
params.doc: Flag to include only active people. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyCustomers
params.doc: Flag to include only customers. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyEmployees
params.doc: Flag to include only employees. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyFamilies
params.doc: Flag to include only families. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyInsurances
params.doc: Flag to include only insurances. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyNotes
params.doc: Flag to only include entries with notes. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyVendors
params.doc: Flag to include only vendors. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyWithImages
params.doc: Flag to include only people with images. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyWithoutCategory
params.doc: Flag to include only people without a category. Defaults to false.

params.name: onlyWithoutRole
params.doc: Flag to include only people without a role. Defaults to false.

params.name: query
params.doc: Fulltext search query.

params.name: sort
params.doc: The column to sort the list by. Defaults to 'name'.

params.name: start
params.doc: The starting entry. Defaults to 0.

operations.title: Export to PDF
operations.doc: Returns a PDF file of the people list.

params.name: categoryId
params.doc: The ID of the category to filter by.

params.name: columns
params.doc: The columns to include in the list, comma-separated. Check the list.json for available column names.

params.name: dir
params.doc: The direction of the sort order (ascending or descending). Defaults to 'ASC'.

params.name: filter

operations.title: Update person
operations.doc: Updates an existing person. Note that all parameters must be submitted, omitted parameters are treated as empty values. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: company
params.doc: The name of the organization / company. Either firstName, lastName or company must be set.

params.name: firstName
params.doc: The person's first (given) name. Either firstName, lastName or company must be set.

params.name: id
params.doc: The ID of the person to update.

params.name: lastName
params.doc: The person's last (family) name. Either firstName, lastName or company must be set.

params.name: addresses
params.doc: A list of addresses (street, house number, zip, city, country). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: type
sub.doc: The type of address. Main address, invoice address, etc.

sub.name: address
sub.doc: The address (street, house number, additional info). Can contain multiple lines.

sub.name: canton
sub.doc: The canton of the address (Switzerland only).

sub.name: city
sub.doc: The town / city of the address.

sub.name: company
sub.doc: Company name of the recipient.

sub.name: country
sub.doc: The country of the address.

sub.name: firstName
sub.doc: First name of the recipient.

sub.name: isHideCompany
sub.doc: Do not display the company name in the document address window.

sub.name: isHideName
sub.doc: Do not display the title, first name and last name in the document address window.

sub.name: lastName
sub.doc: Last name of the recipient.

sub.name: zip
sub.doc: The postal code of the address.

params.name: altName
params.doc: An alternative name for this person (for organizational chart). This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: attachments
params.doc: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: fileId
sub.doc: ID of the file to attach. See File.

params.name: bankAccounts
params.doc: A list of bank accounts (IBAN, BIC). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: iban
sub.doc: The IBAN (International Bank Account Number).

sub.name: type
sub.doc: The type of bank account, i.e. what is the bank account used for?

sub.name: bic
sub.doc: The BIC (Business Identifier Code) of your bank.

sub.name: notes
sub.doc: Some optional notes.

params.name: bankData
params.doc: Unstructured bank information, if IBAN/BIC not available. Otherwise use bankAccounts.

params.name: categoryId
params.doc: The ID of the category. See Person category.

params.name: certificateTemplateId
params.doc: The ID of the salary certificate template. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: certificateValues
params.doc: Values to print directly on the employee's salary certificate. isEmployee must be true, otherwise this is ignored. This overrides any values set on the salary certificate template. This is a map of code -> value, for example: {"F": true, "2.3a": "Bonus"}

params.name: children
params.doc: A list of children. isEmployee or isFamily must be set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: name
sub.doc: Name of the child (first and last name).

sub.name: dateBenefitBegin
sub.doc: Child benefit start date (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateBenefitEnd
sub.doc: Child benefit end date (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateBirth
sub.doc: The child's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateInEducation
sub.doc: Date since child is in education (used for salary statements). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: notes
sub.doc: Some optional notes.

params.name: color
params.doc: The color to use for this person in the organizational chart. Leave empty for white.

params.name: contacts
params.doc: A list of contact information (e-mail, phone, url, etc.). This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: address
sub.doc: The actual contact information (e-mail address, phone number, etc.).

sub.name: type
sub.doc: The type of contact information.

sub.name: notes
sub.doc: Some optional short notes.

params.name: custom
params.doc: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values>. Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: dateBirth
params.doc: The person's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: department
params.doc: The department of the person within the company.

params.name: discountPercentage
params.doc: Discount percentage for this person, which may be used for orders. This can also be set on the category for all people in that category.

params.name: industry
params.doc: The industry of the company or the trade/vocation of the person.

params.name: insuranceContracts
params.doc: A list of insurance contracts, if isInsurance is set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: typeId
sub.doc: ID of the insurance type (e.g. AHV, BVG, etc.).

sub.name: contractNr
sub.doc: Number of the contract with the insurance company.

sub.name: subNr
sub.doc: Optional sub-contract number, if sub-contracts exist.

params.name: insuranceMemberNr
params.doc: Member number (for insurance). isInsurance must be set.

params.name: insuranceNr
params.doc: Insurance number. isInsurance must be set.

params.name: isAutoFillResponsiblePerson
params.doc: Whether to autofill the responsible person field in order documents with this person if userId is set.

params.name: isCustomer
params.doc: Is the person a customer? (role)

params.name: isEmployee
params.doc: Is the person an employee? (role)

params.name: isFamily
params.doc: Is the person a family? (role)

params.name: isInactive
params.doc: Mark the person as inactive. The person will be greyed out and no longer suggested. Defaults to false.

params.name: isInsurance
params.doc: Is the person an insurance company? (role)

params.name: isVendor
params.doc: Is the person a vendor? (role)

params.name: language
params.doc: The main language of the person. May be used for documents.

params.name: locationId
params.doc: The ID of the location (workplace) of the employee. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: notes
params.doc: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: nr
params.doc: The person number (e.g. customer no.).

params.name: position
params.doc: The position (job title) of the person within the company.

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.doc: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the person number (see nr). If this is empty, the sequence number will not update when nr is set. See Sequence number.

params.name: servicePeriods
params.doc: A list of service periods (entry and exit of the employee). isEmployee must be set. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: dateEntry
sub.doc: The entry date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateExit
sub.doc: The exit date. Leave empty if this is the current period. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: notes
sub.doc: Some optional notes.

params.name: ssn
params.doc: Social security number of the employee. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: superiorId
params.doc: The superior of this person (for organizational chart).

params.name: titleId
params.doc: The person's title (e.g. 'Mr.', 'Mrs.', 'Dr.'). See Person title.

params.name: userId
params.doc: The ID of the user linked to this person. This is a user that can login to CashCtrl. isEmployee must be set.

params.name: vatUid
params.doc: The UID (VAT no.) of the company.

params.doc: A partial payment amount per salary statement. Leave empty to pay all open amounts.

params.name: isCombine
params.doc: If set, merges multiple payments to the same payee into one transaction.

params.name: statusId
params.doc: The ID of the new status for the salary statement.

params.name: type
params.doc: The type of payment and file to generate. Defaults to PAIN (pain.001).

params.name: custom
params.doc: Custom field values.

params.name: date
params.doc: The date of the salary statement. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: datePayment
params.doc: The payment date of the salary statement. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: id
params.doc: Optional ID of the existing salary statement.

params.name: personId
params.doc: The ID of the employee. isEmployee must be true on the person object.

params.name: recalculate
params.doc: If id is set, values are not recalculated by default. Set this to true to have them recalculated.

params.name: templateId
params.doc: The salary template to inherit values from. Those values are overriden by valuesLocal.

params.name: types
params.doc: The salary types to calculate the values for. All other salary types won't be calculated.

sub.name: typeId
sub.doc: The ID of the salary type. See Salary type.

sub.name: allocations
sub.doc: Allocations to cost centers. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: share
sub.doc: Allocation share. For example, if you have two cost centers, and one has a share of 3, and the other has a share of 1, then the amount is allocated 3:1 (which equals 75% to 25%).

sub.name: toCostCenterId
sub.doc: ID of cost center to allocate to. See Cost center.

sub.name: creditId
sub.doc: The ID of the account on the credit side. See Account.

sub.name: dateEnd
sub.doc: Optional end date for when this salary type becomes inactive (active otherwise). See also dateStart. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateStart
sub.doc: Optional start date for when this salary type becomes active (inactive otherwise). See also dateEnd. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: debitId
sub.doc: The ID of the account on the debit side. See Account.

sub.name: description
sub.doc: An optional description.

sub.name: onlyMonth
sub.doc: Set the number of the month (january = 1) for when this salary type becomes active (inactive otherwise).

sub.name: rowName
sub.doc: The name as it appears on the salary statement. Leave empty to inherit the name from the salary template or type.

params.name: valuesLocal
params.doc: The values set directly on the salary statement, used for calculation.

operations.title: Create statement
operations.doc: Creates a new statement. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: date
params.doc: The date of the salary statement. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: datePayment
params.doc: The date of payment. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: personId
params.doc: The ID of the person (employee).

params.name: statusId
params.doc: The ID of the current status.

params.name: templateId
params.doc: The ID of the template.

params.name: attachments
params.doc: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: fileId
sub.doc: ID of the file to attach. See File.

params.name: currencyId
params.doc: The ID of the currency. Leave empty to use the default currency.

params.name: currencyRate
params.doc: The exchange rate from foreign currency to main currency. Only required if the currency is not supported or if you want to use a different rate than suggested.

params.name: custom
params.doc: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values>. Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: daysBefore
params.doc: The next salary statement will be created X days before the start date. Leave empty or set to 0 to have the next salary statement created on the start date itself. See recurrence parameter.

params.name: endDate
params.doc: The end date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). Salary statements repeat automatically up until this date, when the recurrence will stop. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: insurances
params.doc: List of insurances. Whether an insurance is mandatory or not depends on the used salary types (see types). Each salary type defines the type of insurance required.

sub.name: contractId
sub.doc: The ID of the insurance contract. Insurance providers are entered as persons, and each insurance provider can have multiple insurance contracts. A contract consists of an insurance type (e.g. AHV/IV/EO/ALV, BVG, UVG, etc.) and a contract number and, if applicable, a sub number. See Person.

sub.name: codeId
sub.doc: The ID of the insurance code (e.g. A1, A2, B1, etc.), if applicable. Each insurance type can have multiple codes. See Insurance type.

params.name: message
params.doc: A message for the payment recipient (included in the pain xml file).

params.name: notes
params.doc: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: notifyEmail
params.doc: The e-mail address to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyPersonId
params.doc: The ID of the person to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyType
params.doc: Whether to send a notification e-mail when salary statements have been created or not. Leave empty to not send any notification.

params.name: notifyUserId
params.doc: The ID of the user to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter. Note: User must be in this organization.

params.name: nr
params.doc: The salary statement number (e.g. 'LA-202401201'). Leave empty to generate the number with sequenceNumberId. This becomes mandatory if a sequence number is set neither here nor in the template.

params.name: recalculate
params.doc: If id is set, values are not recalculated by default. Set this to true to have them recalculated.

params.name: recurrence
params.doc: The interval of how often the salary statement should be automatically repeated. Leave empty to not repeat the salary statement. See also startDate and endDate.

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.doc: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the salary statement number (see nr). If empty, the sequence number of the template is used (if set). See Sequence number.

params.name: startDate
params.doc: The start date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). This is the date when the salary statement will be repeated next. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: types
params.doc: The list of salary types.

sub.name: typeId
sub.doc: The ID of the salary type. See Salary type.

sub.name: allocations
sub.doc: Allocations to cost centers. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: share
sub.doc: Allocation share. For example, if you have two cost centers, and one has a share of 3, and the other has a share of 1, then the amount is allocated 3:1 (which equals 75% to 25%).

sub.name: toCostCenterId
sub.doc: ID of cost center to allocate to. See Cost center.

sub.name: creditId
sub.doc: The ID of the account on the credit side. See Account.

sub.name: dateEnd
sub.doc: Optional end date for when this salary type becomes inactive (active otherwise). See also dateStart. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateStart
sub.doc: Optional start date for when this salary type becomes active (inactive otherwise). See also dateEnd. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: debitId
sub.doc: The ID of the account on the debit side. See Account.

sub.name: description
sub.doc: An optional description.

sub.name: onlyMonth
sub.doc: Set the number of the month (january = 1) for when this salary type becomes active (inactive otherwise).

sub.name: rowName
sub.doc: The name as it appears on the salary statement. Leave empty to inherit the name from the salary template or type.

params.doc: A JSON object containing each salary type's field values. This is a simple key/value pair map (the key being the variable name).

params.name: onlyOverdue

params.doc: Fulltext search query.

params.doc: The date of the salary statement. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.doc: The date of payment. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.doc: The ID of the salary statement to update.

params.doc: The ID of the person (employee).

params.name: statusId
params.doc: The ID of the current status.

params.doc: The ID of the template.

params.name: attachments
params.doc: List of files to attach. This is a JSON array [{...},{...},...] with the following parameters:

sub.name: fileId
sub.doc: ID of the file to attach. See File.

params.name: currencyId
params.doc: The ID of the currency. Leave empty to use the default currency.

params.name: currencyRate
params.doc: The exchange rate from foreign currency to main currency. Only required if the currency is not supported or if you want to use a different rate than suggested.

params.name: custom
params.doc: Custom field values. They are stored as XML in this parameter. Example: <values><customField1>My value</customField1><customField2>["value 1","value 2"]</customField2></values>. Look up custom field variable names (e.g. "customField1") in the Custom fields API.

params.name: daysBefore
params.doc: The next salary statement will be created X days before the start date. Leave empty or set to 0 to have the next salary statement created on the start date itself. See recurrence parameter.

params.name: endDate
params.doc: The end date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). Salary statements repeat automatically up until this date, when the recurrence will stop. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: insurances
params.doc: List of insurances. Whether an insurance is mandatory or not depends on the used salary types (see types). Each salary type defines the type of insurance required.

sub.name: contractId
sub.doc: The ID of the insurance contract. Insurance providers are entered as persons, and each insurance provider can have multiple insurance contracts. A contract consists of an insurance type (e.g. AHV/IV/EO/ALV, BVG, UVG, etc.) and a contract number and, if applicable, a sub number. See Person.

sub.name: codeId
sub.doc: The ID of the insurance code (e.g. A1, A2, B1, etc.), if applicable. Each insurance type can have multiple codes. See Insurance type.

params.name: message
params.doc: A message for the payment recipient (included in the pain xml file).

params.name: notes
params.doc: Some optional notes. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

params.name: notifyEmail
params.doc: The e-mail address to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyPersonId
params.doc: The ID of the person to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter.

params.name: notifyType
params.doc: Whether to send a notification e-mail when salary statements have been created or not. Leave empty to not send any notification.

params.name: notifyUserId
params.doc: The ID of the user to send a notification to. See notifyType parameter. Note: User must be in this organization.

params.name: nr
params.doc: The salary statement number (e.g. 'LA-202401201'). Leave empty to generate the number with sequenceNumberId. This becomes mandatory if a sequence number is set neither here nor in the template.

params.name: recalculate
params.doc: If id is set, values are not recalculated by default. Set this to true to have them recalculated.

params.name: recurrence
params.doc: The interval of how often the salary statement should be automatically repeated. Leave empty to not repeat the salary statement. See also startDate and endDate.

params.name: sequenceNumberId
params.doc: The ID of the sequence number used to generate the salary statement number (see nr). If empty, the sequence number of the template is used (if set). See Sequence number.

params.name: startDate
params.doc: The start date for the recurrence (see recurrence parameter). This is the date when the salary statement will be repeated next. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

params.name: types

sub.doc: The ID of the salary type. See Salary type.

sub.name: share
sub.doc: Allocation share. For example, if you have two cost centers, and one has a share of 3, and the other has a share of 1, then the amount is allocated 3:1 (which equals 75% to 25%).

sub.name: toCostCenterId
sub.doc: ID of cost center to allocate to. See Cost center.

sub.name: creditId
sub.doc: The ID of the account on the credit side. See Account.

sub.name: dateEnd
sub.doc: Optional end date for when this salary type becomes inactive (active otherwise). See also dateStart. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: dateStart
sub.doc: Optional start date for when this salary type becomes active (inactive otherwise). See also dateEnd. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: debitId
sub.doc: The ID of the account on the debit side. See Account.

sub.name: description
sub.doc: An optional description.

sub.name: onlyMonth
sub.doc: Set the number of the month (january = 1) for when this salary type becomes active (inactive otherwise).

sub.name: rowName
sub.doc: The name as it appears on the salary statement. Leave empty to inherit the name from the salary template or type.

params.name: valuesLocal
params.doc: A JSON object containing each salary type's field values. This is a simple key/value pair map (the key being the variable name).

params.doc: The name of the status. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.doc: An action associated with the status, i.e. what happens after I change the status to this?

params.name: isBook
params.doc: Whether journal book entries will be created with this status. For example, the status 'Draft' will not create any book entries, but all the other statuses after that ('Open', 'Paid', etc.) will. Defaults to false.

params.name: isClosed
params.doc: Whether the status closes / completes the salary statement. This would be the case, for example, if the salary has been fully paid. The effect is that the salary is no longer due, even if past the due date (so no longer marked red). Defaults to false.

operations.title: Create sequence number
operations.doc: Creates a new sequence number. Note that you cannot assign the sequence number to a type (e.g. Journal) here, this is done in the Settings or in the corresponding category (e.g. Order category). Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: name
params.doc: A name to describe and identify the sequence number. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: pattern
params.doc: The sequence number pattern, which consists of variables and arbitrary text from which a sequence number will be generated. Possible variables: $y = Current year. $m = Current month. $d = Current day. $ny = Sequence number, resets annually (on Jan 1st). $nm = Sequence number, resets monthly. $nd = Sequence number, resets daily. $nn = Sequence number, never resets. Example pattern: RE-$y$m$d$nd which may generate 'RE-2007151' (on July 15, 2020).

params.name: currentDailyNumber
params.doc: The current value of the daily number (variable $nd). Defaults to 1.

params.name: currentInfiniteNumber
params.doc: The current value of the infinite number (variable $nn). Defaults to 1.

params.name: currentMonthlyNumber
params.doc: The current value of the monthly number (variable $nm). Defaults to 1.

params.name: currentYearlyNumber
params.doc: The current value of the yearly number (variable $ny). Defaults to 1.

params.name: dailyNumberDigits
params.doc: The number of digits for the daily number (variable $nd). If the number of digits are lower than this, the number will be prepended by zeroes (e.g. 0001 if 4 digits). Defaults to 1.

params.name: dayDigits
params.doc: The number of digits for the current day (variable $d). Defaults to 2.

params.name: infiniteNumberDigits
params.doc: The number of digits for the infinite number (variable $nn). If the number of digits are lower than this, the number will be prepended by zeroes (e.g. 0001 if 4 digits). Defaults to 1.

params.name: isSkipExisting
params.doc: Automatically skip existing sequence numbers? Example: If the next number is 500, but 500 already exists, it will increment the sequence number until a free one is found (max. 100 tries).

params.name: monthDigits
params.doc: The number of digits for the current month (variable $m). Defaults to 2.

params.name: monthlyNumberDigits
params.doc: The number of digits for the monthly number (variable $nm). If the number of digits are lower than this, the number will be prepended by zeroes (e.g. 0001 if 4 digits). Defaults to 1.

params.name: yearDigits
params.doc: The number of digits for the current year (variable $y). Defaults to 4.

params.name: yearlyNumberDigits
params.doc: The number of digits for the yearly number (variable $ny). If the number of digits are lower than this, the number will be prepended by zeroes (e.g. 0001 if 4 digits). Defaults to 1.

sub.doc: The application rule, on which account (debit or credit side) the tax is applied.

sub.name: calcType
sub.doc: The calculation basis, how the tax is calculated (either based on the net amount or gross amount).

sub.doc: One or multiple codes, comma-separated, corresponding to the code on the tax return form from the ESTV. Example: 200,303

params.doc: Tax rates that are valid from a given date. Add a new tax rate here if the official tax rate changes. Exactly one tax rate must exist without a valid from date.

sub.name: percentage
sub.doc: The tax rate percentage (e.g. 8.1).

sub.doc: The date from which the tax rate will be used. One of the tax rates must have no dateValid set, that is the fallback tax rate. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.doc: The net/flat tax rate percentage (e.g. 5.9), if net or flat tax rate method is used, otherwise leave empty.

sub.doc: The tax rate percentage (e.g. 8.1).

sub.name: dateValid
sub.doc: The date from which the tax rate will be used. One of the tax rates must have no dateValid set, that is the fallback tax rate. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2020-01-15.

sub.name: percentageFlat
sub.doc: The net/flat tax rate percentage (e.g. 5.9), if net or flat tax rate method is used, otherwise leave empty.

params.name: description
params.doc: A description for the tax code. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: documentName
params.doc: The name for the tax code displayed on documents (seen by customers). If isDisplayTaxRate is set, this name doesn't have to include the tax rate percentage, it will be automatically appended. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: isDisplayTaxRate
params.doc: Whether to automatically append the current tax rate to the document name (see documentName) or not.

params.name: isInactive
params.doc: Mark the tax code as inactive. This means that the tax code is greyed out and no longer suggested. Tax codes already in use cannot be deleted, but you can always set them as inactive. Defaults to false.

operations.title: Create text template
operations.doc: Creates a new text template. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: name
params.doc: A name to describe and identify the text template.

params.name: type
params.doc: The type of text template, meaning: Where the text template can be used.

params.name: isDefault
params.doc: Sets the text template as the default text template. Note that text templates defined in order categories are preferred over the default text template, see Order category. Defaults to false.

params.name: value
params.doc: The actual text template. This can contain limited HTML for styling. Allowed tags: a, p, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, li, blockquote, b, i, s, u, o, sup, sub, ins, del, strong, strike, tt, code, big, small, br, span, em. Allowed inline CSS rules: background, background-color, color, font, font-size, font-weight, font-style, text-align, text-indent, text-decoration.

operations.title: Delete text template
operations.doc: Deletes one or multiple text templates. Returns either a success or error message.

params.name: ids
params.doc: The IDs of the selected entries, comma-separated.

operations.title: List text templates
operations.doc: Returns a list of text templates by type.

params.name: type
params.doc: The type of text template, meaning: Where the text template can be used.

operations.title: Read text template
operations.doc: Returns a single text template by ID.

params.name: id
params.doc: The ID of the entry.

operations.title: Update text template
operations.doc: Updates an existing text template. Note that all parameters must be submitted, omitted parameters are treated as empty values. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: id
params.doc: The ID of the text template to update.

params.name: name
params.doc: A name to describe and identify the text template.

params.name: type
params.doc: The type of text template, meaning: Where the text template can be used.

params.name: isDefault
params.doc: Sets the text template as the default text template. Note that text templates defined in order categories are preferred over the default text template, see Order category. Defaults to false.

params.name: value
params.doc: The actual text template. This can contain limited HTML for styling.
